travel_dk.h: A 44-year-old mathematician who had posted his proof of the Poincaré conjecture as three arXiv preprints totaling 68 pages refused the Clay Institute’s $1,000,000 Millennium Prize on July 1, 2010. He never published the proof anywhere else himself, though other mathematicians spent years elaborating and republishing it in peer-reviewed form.
